comment.narrative: The project in collaboration with partners from child welfare Civil Society Organisations CSOs made significant advocacy efforts that resulted in the signing of an InterMinisterial Order to support the implementation of the Government Decree no.143 on the Instructions on the Mechanism of interagency cooperation for primary prevention of child wellbeing risks hereinafter referred to as Primary Prevention Mechanism. The Ministry of Labour and Social Protection MLSP the Ministry of Education and Research MER and the Ministry of Health MH joined efforts to adopt a set of tools aimed at strengthening the capacity of communities to prevent primary risks to children. At the local level capacitybuilding programmes and support led to enhanced childcare service provision and engagement of stakeholders including children and parents. Decisionmakers and professionals from the social work education and health fields were trained in the provision of improved childcare services.
